headline: Sensex crashes 900 points, Nifty falls below 22,900 as India VIX surges 15% amid rate hike fears

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Speculation over RBI rate hikes of up to 50 bps by December following Nomura's report
Rising Japanese bond yields and expectations of Bank of Japan monetary tightening
Persistent underperformance and valuation gaps in major Indian consumer stocks
Negative global cues from Asian markets and a weak start signaled by GIFT Nifty
whatHappening: BSE Sensex plummeted over 900 points intraday, hitting a three-month low
NSE Nifty 50 dropped below the 22,900 level during a sharp market sell-off
India VIX volatility index surged by 15%, reflecting increased investor anxiety
Investors lost approximately Rs 6 lakh crore in market capitalization during the crash
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a severe crash with the Sensex and Nifty losing significant ground amid fears of RBI rate hikes and global bond market volatility. While the India VIX spiked 15% and investor wealth eroded by Rs 6 lakh crore, Sun Pharma bucked the trend by securing rights to a major cholesterol drug. Analysts suggest further pain may persist until the market finds a bottom in October 2026.
